videos.video_subject: At the age of fifteen Cristiano Ronaldo was diagnosed with tachycardia, a racing heart that would not slow down even at rest, and Sporting Lisbon told his mother Dolores that the condition could end his football career before it began
videos.video_script: At fifteen his heart would not slow down. The doctors called it tachycardia. They told his mother he might never play football again.
